UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

LANG_COMPONENT_KEYS

Frozen lang component key map — sole declaration site for these tokens; consumers read members and never re-declare the strings (zero-hardcoding rules 4–5). Object.freeze makes the token contract immutable at runtime.
